## CheatReader v0.1.28

### Fixes
- Page Down, Page Up, custom page shortcuts, and page-granularity automatic turning now keep one visual line of overlap between pages (#21).
- Fixed Ubuntu 20.04 packages that could install successfully but fail to start when only the legacy AppIndicator runtime was installed (#22).

### Root causes
- Page navigation previously advanced by the full number of calculated visible lines. Even when the underlying text positions were contiguous, the last line at the viewport boundary could be hard to confirm or partially clipped by desktop font and window metrics, making the next page appear to have skipped one line. Page movement now advances by one less than the visible capacity so the previous page's last line becomes the next page's first line.
- The Linux build links `libtray_manager_plugin.so` against `libayatana-appindicator3.so.1`, but the Debian package incorrectly declared `libayatana-appindicator3-1 | libappindicator3-1`. Those packages expose different SONAMEs and are not interchangeable for one already-built binary. On Ubuntu 20.04 with only `libappindicator3-1`, `dpkg` therefore accepted the package but the dynamic loader exited before CheatReader could open. The package now requires the exact Ayatana runtime used at build time.

### Release safeguards
- Linux release packaging now checks that the Debian dependency matches the tray plugin's ELF dependency before upload.
- Desktop releases now use a pinned Flutter 3.44.6 toolchain so rebuilding a tag does not silently pick up a different stable SDK.

### Suggested verification
- For #21, set line spacing to the minimum, resize the reader to several different heights and widths, and test Page Down/Page Up plus custom page shortcuts. The last line of one page should repeat as the first line of the next page, with no unread text skipped.
- For #22, install the amd64 package on Ubuntu 20.04 with `sudo apt install ./cheatreader-v0.1.28-linux-amd64.deb`, then start `/opt/cheatreader/cheatreader`. APT should install `libayatana-appindicator3-1` when needed and the window should open normally.
